# Configuration Files Summary

## Overview
This document summarizes the configuration files available for analysis. Due to file access limitations, only partial configuration data is available.

  "appName": "SampleApp",

| Environment | development | Not Found | Not Found |

## Notable Differences
- Only development environment configuration files were accessible
- Production and testing environment configuration files could not be located
- No comparison can be made between environments due to missing files

## Observations
1. The available configuration follows a standard structure with application metadata, environment settings, and database configuration
2. Feature flags are used to enable/disable functionality
3. The database configuration uses PostgreSQL default port (5432)
4. Missing production and testing configurations prevent a complete environment comparison

## Recommendations
1. Verify the location of prod.config.json and test.config.json files
2. Ensure all environment configurations are accessible for proper comparison
3. Consider implementing consistent naming conventions across all environment configuration files
